# .NET MAUI {{ControlName}} Commands

The Telerik .NET MAUI {{ControlName}} exposes the following commands:

* `CommandName` (`ICommand`)&mdash;{{Description.}} The command parameter is of type `{{ParamType}}`.
* `CommandName` (`ICommand`)&mdash;{{Description.}} The command parameter is of type `{{ParamType}}`.

## Using the Commands

The following example demonstrates how to use the `{{CommandName}}`.

1. Define the {{ControlName}} in XAML:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-{{command-slug}}-xaml' />

1. Add the `telerik` namespace:

    ```XAML
    xmlns:telerik="http://schemas.telerik.com/2022/xaml/maui"
    ```

1. Define the command in your view model:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-{{command-slug}}' />

> For a runnable example demonstrating the {{ControlName}} commands, see the [SDKBrowser Demo Application]({% slug sdkbrowser-app %}) and go to the **{{ControlName}} > Commands** category.
